characterDeckComponents.note: The character traces a person's head and neck seen from the side; 'page' is a later, borrowed meaning.
氵 (water) — steeping, soaking, and bubbles all involve water.
包 (bāo) gives a sound fairly close to pào, sharing the rhyme and differing mainly in aspiration.
衣 (clothing) — 袋 names something made of cloth or similar material, a bag.
代 (dài) is an exact match for the sound of 袋.
石 (stone) — 硬 describes something as hard and firm as stone.
更 (gèng) gives a sound distantly related to yìng, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: to administer, to govern, to regulate

etymology.hint: A structure 台 that directs the flow of water 氵

characterDeckComponents.note: 氵 (water) — 治 relates to managing or controlling the flow of water, such as flood control.
台 (a platform, structure) — a structure used to direct and control water gave 治 its meaning 'to govern' or 'to manage.'

etymology.hint: A spade or other workman's tool

characterDeckComponents.note: 工 depicts a carpenter's square or workman's tool — a simple shape that came to represent work and labor.

meanings: used in 南無|南无[na1 mo2]

characterDeckComponents.note: Originally a pictograph of a musical bell or instrument hung in a frame; this shape was later reused to write the unrelated directional word 南, 'south.'

meanings: (bound form) Austria (abbr. for 奧地利|奥地利[Ao4 di4 li4])

makemeahanzi.definition: mysterious, obscure, profound; used in transliterations

etymology.hint: A person 大 discovering a house 宀 full of rice 米

characterDeckComponents.note: 宀 (roof) depicts a house.
米 (rice) — a house full of rice suggested something deep and abundant, hidden within.
大 (a person) — a person discovering hidden depths gave 奥 its meaning 'mysterious, profound.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to consent, to permit; to promise, to betroth

characterDeckComponents.note: 讠 (speech) — 许 relates to giving permission through words.
午 (wǔ) gives a hint of the sound — 许 is pronounced xǔ, a connection that has shifted significantly over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: to marry, to take a wife

etymology.hint: To take 取 a wife 女; 取 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 取 means 'to take, to obtain' — pictured here on top.
女 (woman) sits below — together with 取, the image is of 'taking a woman [as a wife],' giving 娶 its meaning 'to marry (a woman).'
文 depicts a chest marked with crossing lines, once tattoos or patterns on the body — decoration and pattern gave rise to the idea of 'writing' and 'culture.'

makemeahanzi.definition: a period of time; date, time; phase

characterDeckComponents.note: 月 (moon) — 期 relates to time measured by the moon's cycles, like a period or term.
其 (qí) gives a hint of the sound — 期 is pronounced qī, a connection that has shifted slightly in tone.

makemeahanzi.definition: to stick, to paste; attached; allowance, subsidy

characterDeckComponents.note: 贝 (money) — 贴 originally referred to pawning something for money, extending to 'to stick on, to subsidize.'
占 (zhàn) is only distantly related in sound to tiē — the connection has drifted apart over time.
口 (mouth) — 哟 is a sound made with the mouth.
约 (yuē) gives a sound distantly related to yō, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: to build, to erect; to establish, to found

characterDeckComponents.note: 廴 (to move forward, extend) — 建 relates to constructing or setting something up over an extended process.
聿 (yù) gives a hint of the sound — 建 is pronounced jiàn, a connection that has shifted significantly over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: ridge-beam; the main support of a house

characterDeckComponents.note: 木 (wood) — 栋 named the main wooden beam holding up a roof, and now works as a measure word for buildings.
东 (dōng) gives a sound close to dòng, the same syllable with a different tone.
A drawing of a tree trunk with branches spreading up and roots below.

makemeahanzi.definition: sphere, circle, ball; mass, lump; group, regiment; to gather

etymology.hint: A lot of talent 才 gathered in one place 囗

characterDeckComponents.note: 才 (talent) — many talented people.
囗 (an enclosure) — gathered together in one place, giving 团 its meaning 'group, team; round, ball-shaped.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to drill, to exercise; to practice, to train

characterDeckComponents.note: 纟 (thread) — 练 originally meant to boil and whiten silk thread, extending to 'to practice, to train' through repeated refinement.
柬 (jiǎn) gives a sound distantly related to liàn, having drifted apart over time.
木 (tree/wood) — 桥 names a structure traditionally built of wood.
乔 (qiáo) is an exact match for the sound of 桥.

makemeahanzi.definition: to advance, to enlighten, to make progress

etymology.hint: To walk 辶 with purpose 由

characterDeckComponents.note: 辶 (walk/movement) — 迪 describes moving forward.
由 (a source, a path from) — walking 辶 from a clear starting point 由 gave 迪 its meaning 'to guide, to enlighten.'

meanings: (bound form) standard weight used with a balance scale

characterDeckComponents.note: 石 (stone) — 码 originally related to counting stones used for reckoning, extended to mean 'number, code.'
马 (mǎ) is an exact match for the sound of 码.

etymology.hint: A red pellet 丶 from a mine 井

characterDeckComponents.note: 丹 depicts a pellet of red cinnabar mineral, dug from a mine — the source of its meaning 'cinnabar, red, pellet.'

meanings: (bound form) Iraq (abbr. for 伊拉克[Yi1 la1 ke4])
(bound form) Iran (abbr. for 伊朗[Yi1 lang3])

makemeahanzi.definition: he she; this, that; used in transliterations

characterDeckComponents.note: 亻 (person) — 伊 originally referred to a person
尹 (yǐn) gives a sound close to 伊's reading yī, sharing a similar historical pronunciation

makemeahanzi.definition: to prove, to verify; certificate, proof

etymology.hint: To speak 讠 the truth 正; 正 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 讠 (speech) — the act of speaking.
正 (straight, correct) — speaking the straight, correct truth, giving 证 its meaning 'to prove, certify; evidence.'
母 depicts a kneeling woman with two dots marking breasts — an image emphasizing nursing and motherhood, giving 母 its meaning 'mother.'

meanings: mic (abbr. for 麥克風|麦克风[mai4 ke4 feng1])

etymology.hint: Simplified form of 麦; grains 來 ready to be harvested 夂

characterDeckComponents.note: 龶-shaped top pictures a ripe stalk of grain.
夂 below pictures roots or a foot, together giving 麦 its meaning 'wheat.'

makemeahanzi.definition: love; to yearn for, to long for

characterDeckComponents.note: 心 (heart) — 恋 describes a heart drawn to and longing for someone or something.
亦 (yì) is only distantly related in sound to liàn — the connection has drifted apart to the point of being barely recognizable.

makemeahanzi.definition: the classics; to experience, to undergo

characterDeckComponents.note: 纟 (silk/thread) — 经 originally referred to the vertical warp threads in weaving.
工 (gōng) gives a related sound cue for 经 (jīng), reflecting an older, closer pronunciation link between the two.
忄 (heart) — 惨 describes a heart-wrenching, miserable feeling.
参 (cān) gives a sound very close to cǎn, sharing the initial and rhyme — only the tone differs.

meanings: (of two or more persons) to carry

makemeahanzi.definition: to carry, to lift, to raise

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — 抬 describes lifting or carrying something by hand.
台 (tái) gives the sound — an exact match with 抬.

meanings: classifier for blows of a sword

characterDeckComponents.note: 刂 (knife) — 剑 names an edged weapon, a sword.
佥 (qiān) reflects the character's historical phonetic root, though it has diverged from the modern reading jiàn.

makemeahanzi.definition: piece, roll, strip; breadth, width; measure word for textiles

etymology.hint: A roll 畐 of cloth 巾; 畐 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 巾 (cloth) — 幅 measures a length of cloth.
畐 depicts a full, rounded container — the sense of a full, rolled-out width of cloth gave 幅 its meaning 'width, a roll of cloth.'
氵 (water) — 注 relates to pouring or directing, like water poured into something
主 (zhǔ) gives a sound close to 注's reading zhù

makemeahanzi.definition: words, speech; to speak, to say

etymology.hint: A tongue sticking out of a mouth 口

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — with strokes above depicting a tongue sticking out — the image of speaking, the source of 言's meaning 'speech, words, language.'
足 (foot) — 踩 is an action done with the foot.
采 (cǎi) gives the sound — an exact match with 踩.

makemeahanzi.definition: to endure, to bear, to suffer, to tolerate

etymology.hint: A knife 刃 piercing the heart 心; 刃 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 刃 (blade) pictures something sharp and painful.
心 (heart) below suggests bearing pain in one's heart, giving 忍 its meaning 'to endure.'
Thread/silk — patterns were originally woven into cloth.
Gives the sound wén, matching the character's reading.

makemeahanzi.definition: to change, to convert, to reform; -ize
scissors; to cut, to divide, to separate

characterDeckComponents.note: 刀 (knife) — 剪 names a cutting tool, scissors.
前 (qián) is close in initial to jiǎn (q-/j- are a related palatal family), though the rhyme has drifted.

makemeahanzi.definition: to judge; to discriminate; to conclude

characterDeckComponents.note: 刂 (knife) — 判 originally related to cutting something apart to distinguish or decide
半 (bàn) gives a sound close to 判's reading pàn, sharing a similar historical pronunciation

etymology.hint: A heart ⺼ in the chest 匈; 匈 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: ⺼ (flesh/body) — part of the body.
匈 here representing an enclosed cavity, together giving 胸 its meaning 'chest, breast.'

etymology.hint: A violent 暴 flame 火; 暴 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 火 (fire) — flame at the heart of the picture.
暴 (violent, sudden) — a burst of intense fire, together giving 爆 its meaning 'to explode, burst.'

meanings: to hold up in one's hand
sth serving as a support: a prop, a rest

makemeahanzi.definition: to raise, to support; to entrust, to rely on

etymology.hint: Using one's hands 扌 for support 乇; 乇 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — a hand held out, palm up
乇 — something resting on the upturned palm for support
虫 (insect, bug, used broadly for small creatures) shows 蛇 names an animal.
它 (tā) gives a sound distantly related to shé, having drifted apart over time.

etymology.hint: Two people 匕 sitting back-to-back; phonetic loan for "north"

characterDeckComponents.note: 匕 (a person), doubled and mirrored — two people standing back-to-back; this shape was later reused to write the unrelated directional meaning 'north.'

meanings: to serve (in the military, a prison sentence etc)

makemeahanzi.definition: clothes; to dress, to wear; to take medicine

etymology.hint: A person 卩 putting on 又 a coat 月

characterDeckComponents.note: 卩 (a person) — the one being dressed.
月 (a garment shape) — a hand 又 placing a coat on the person, giving 服 its meaning 'clothes; to obey, submit.'
糸 (thread/silk) — 系 relates to connecting or tying things together, like threads linking into a system.

etymology.hint: To damage 害 one's eyes 目; 害 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 目 (eye) shows this relates to sight.
害 (to harm) shows damage being done — together giving 瞎's meaning 'blind.'
